lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh giaan eko hai jaataa anadin naam raveejai he ||13||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh knows the spiritual wisdom of the One Lord. Night and day, he chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed paRahi har naam na boojhahi ||
lines.translation: He may read the Vedas, but he does not realize the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਲੂਝਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kaaran paR paR loojhahi ||
lines.translation: For the sake of Maya, he reads and recites and argues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar mail agiaanee a(n)dhaa kiu kar dutar tareejai he ||14||
lines.translation: The ignorant and blind person is filled with filth within. How can he cross over the impassable world-ocean? ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed baad sabh aakh vakhaanahi ||
lines.translation: He voices all the controversies of the Vedas,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: na a(n)tar bheejai na sabad pachhaanahi ||
lines.translation: but his inner being is not saturated or satisfied, and he does not realize the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: pu(n)n paap sabh bed driRaaiaa guramukh a(n)mrit peejai he ||15||
lines.translation: The Vedas tell all about virtue and vice, but only the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saachaa eko soee ||
lines.translation: The One True Lord is all by Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koee ||
lines.translation: There is no one else except Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate man saachaa sacho sach raveejai he ||16||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, true is the mind of one who is attuned to the Naam; he speaks Truth, and nothing but Truth. ||16||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sachaa takhat rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord has established the Throne of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vasiaa tithai mohu na maaiaa ||
lines.translation: He dwells in His own home deep within the self, where there is no emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sad hee saach vasiaa ghat a(n)tar guramukh karanee saaree he ||1||
lines.translation: The True Lord dwells deep within the nucleus of the Gurmukh's heart forever; his actions are excellent. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saudaa sach vaapaaraa ||
lines.translation: True is his merchandise, and true is his trade.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: na tithai bharam na doojaa pasaaraa ||
lines.translation: There is no doubt within him, and no expanse of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa dhan khatiaa kade tot na aavai boojhai ko veechaaree he ||2||
lines.translation: He has earned the true wealth, which is never exhausted. How few are those who contemplate this, and understand. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai laae se jan laage ||
lines.translation: They alone are attached to the True Name, whom the Lord Himself attaches.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar sabad masatak vadabhaage ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad is deep within the nucleus of the self; good fortune is recorded upon their foreheads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa gun gaavahi sabad rate veechaaree he ||3||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing the True Praises of the Lord; they are attuned to contemplative meditation on the Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sachaa sach saalaahee ||
lines.translation: I praise the True Lord, the Truest of the True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko vekhaa doojaa naahee ||
lines.translation: I see the One Lord, and no other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramat oocho oochee pauRee giaan ratan haumai maaree he ||4||
lines.translation: The Guru's Teachings are the ladder to reach the highest of the high. the jewel of spiritual wisdom conquers egotism. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabad jalaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach man vasiaa jaa tudh bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True One comes to dwell in the mind, when it pleases You, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sache kee sabh sachee karanee haumai tikhaa nivaaree he ||5||
lines.translation: True are all the actions of the truthful; the thirst of egotism is subdued. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh aape keenaa ||
lines.translation: All by Himself, God created emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh viralai kin hee cheenaa ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s sach kamaavai saachee karanee saaree he ||6||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh practices Truth; true and excellent are his actions. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaar kamaaee jo mere prabh bhaaee ||
lines.translation: He does those deeds which are pleasing to my God;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai trisanaa sabad bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: through the Shabad, he burns away egotism and the thirst of desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: guramat sad hee a(n)tar seetal haumai maar nivaaree he ||7||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, he remains forever cool and calm deep within; he conquers and subdues his ego. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach lage tin sabh kichh bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Those who are attached to the Truth are pleased with everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabade sach suhaavai ||
lines.translation: They are embellished with the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: aithai saache se dar saache nadaree nadar savaaree he ||8||
lines.translation: Those who are true in this world, are true in the Court of the Lord. The Merciful Lord adorns them with His Mercy. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin saache jo doojai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are attached to duality, and not the Truth,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa moh dukh sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya; they totally suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur dukh sukh jaapai naahee maaiaa moh dukh bhaaree he ||9||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, they do not understand pain and pleasure; attached to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa sabad jinaa man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those whose minds are pleased with the True Word of the Shabad

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhiaa tinee kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: act according to pre-ordained destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sevahi sach dhiaavahi sach rate veechaaree he ||10||
lines.translation: They serve the True Lord, and meditate on the True Lord; they are imbued with contemplative meditation on the True Lord. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee sevaa meethee laagee ||
lines.translation: Service to the Guru seems sweet to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sookh sahaj samaadhee ||
lines.translation: Night and day, they are intuitively immersed in celestial peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har karatiaa man niramal hoaa gur kee sev piaaree he ||11||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds become immaculate; they love to serve the Guru. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan sukheee satigur sache laae ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings are at peace, whom the True Guru attaches to the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bhaane aap milaae ||
lines.translation: He Himself, in His Will, merges them into Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur raakhe se jan ubare hor maaiaa moh khuaaree he ||12||
lines.translation: Those humble beings, whom the True Guru protects, are saved. The rest are ruined through emotional attachment to Maya. ||12||
